items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: I remember he had a fight with a cat named Charlie, a one-legged guy who sang like a tenor -- Charlie Henderson.

ctx.x: The Lyric. We went on there for the Amateur Hour. The stage doorman was Chinese. And I remember he had a fight with a cat named Charlie, a one-legged guy who sang like a tenor -- Charlie Henderson. You might have seen him in Chicago. He came out with a white full-dress suit and one leg. It was a cork leg, you couldn't see it. But he sang tenor. They got in an argument. They had an argument backstage about some woman. And the Chinese threatened to kill him and all that shit, and he was going to get his pistol and…
So we won the amateur prize, which was five dollars...
